role: Read-only source review of frozen trial; no new fitting, model inference, scores or evaluation outcomes.

checks.evidence: run_trial.observation uses original full-frame K, integer pixel offset0, native inclusive ROI, finite positive camera-Z depth and abs observed-plane distance >0.002m, matching frozen DINO preparation.

prepare copies only mesh path/hash/native extents; depth/K/observed plane/ROIs; frozen CLIP candidate IDs; frozen DINO global/patch/coverage. No scene XML/world transform/simulator poses/segmentation/identity read in fitting or selection.
Original metric STL vertices retained; no fitted scale; poses map native CAD to camera. Contact uses mesh vertex minimum along observed plane normal.

CAD-only stable support normals; axes-priority preserves both round-pin ends and side directions; up to12directions,36yaw seeds andcontinuous x/y/yawICP. Audit checks all12native meshes. No scene-selected resting face used.
table_frame normalizes plane and flips normal+offset if observed mean has negative height. Fitted minimum table height is asserted for each pose.

Full projected/observed union; exact camera first-hit CAD depth; no external-occluder carving or table-penetration acceptance gate. Depth disagreement only on valid observed-object/CAD overlap; no overlap remains unavailable.
geometry projection explicitly uses pixeloffset0 rather than helper default0.5. Camera-Z rays have z=1, preserving camera-Z hit depth.
Zero contact is primary; separately declared1mm syntheticcapture-clearance sensitivity. No per-object clearance estimate from audit placement.
Exactly96tasks×5sameCLIPcandidateIDs=480pairs; frozen DINOglobal/patch/coverage unchanged. No CLIP expansion or recomputation. Any incomplete five-candidate arm is unavailable; no fallback.

select_results verifies480fithashes andprotocolhash, writes672label-free selections andselection_completion with evaluation_labels_read false. analyze_results raises before readinglabels unlesscompletion andallhashesverify.

limitations: Depth and camera are ideal simulator measurements; real-sensor noise, missing depth and calibration error are not established.
Support-plane model and static support assumptions can be wrong on real observations.
Root reports12geometryregressiontests passed; this review did not independently refit or execute model inference.
Strict CLIP shortlist prevents rescuing its one excluded true crop.
Scores remain uncalibrated; reusedscenes are development evidence, not held-out or real-image validation.
